verdict.rationale: The evidence documents MailerSend webhooks: event subscriptions, retries with exponential backoff, and a reachability test request on creation. Nothing in the pack mentions signed payloads, signing secrets, or signature verification code, so the authenticity capability is unevidenced. The reachability test checks the endpoint URL and is not payload authentication.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can verify webhook authenticity — signed payloads with documented signature verification code — so spoofed events can't poison my delivery state
